title: Incremental updates preserve PDF old object bytes
summary: PDF can append changed objects and cross-references. The final startxref locates the current cross-reference, and Prev links to earlier ones.
detail: Searching for a text directly in the original bytes may find a copy that has been replaced by a new version of the object; interpreting the current page depends on the current cross-reference.
boundary: Cross-references can be carried by traditional tables or cross-reference streams; looking only for literal xrefs misses the latter.
relevance: Distinguish between the historical content in the attachment and the current document actually displayed by the reader.
